meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided, and on what basis?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided, and on what basis.
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You want me to tell you how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, Hale, and answer my question.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? Third time, Hale: who decided, and on what basis?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for how it was entered, and that I be told who decided it and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreeing to nothing and still wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer about who decided and on what basis.
What moved her: nothing, because Hale never answered her question or showed her any document.
What cost ground: praising her and saying you were on the same team, because she reads flattery as being managed and it never moves her.
Try next time: when she first asks who decided and on what basis, say in one sentence that the zero should not have gone in before anyone called her, then name who decided and put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her.
